#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int length;
    cin >> length;
    cin.ignore(); // consume newline after integer
    string str;
    getline(cin, str);

    int maxLength = 0;
    int countLength = 0;
    int countWord = 0;
    int checker = 0;
    int checkerInside = 0;
    bool isInWordOut = false;
    bool isInWordIn = false;
    bool isInside = false;

    int index = 0;

    while (index < length) {
        if (str[index] == '(') {
            isInside = true;
            checkerInside++;
            if (maxLength < countLength)
                maxLength = countLength;
            countLength = 0;
            isInWordOut = false;
        } else if (str[index] == ')') {
            isInside = false;
            checkerInside = 0;
            if (checker > 0) {
                countWord++;
                checker = 0;
            }
        } else {
            if (checkerInside > 0) {
                isInside = true;
            }
        }

        if (index == length)
            break;

        if (str[index] != ')' && str[index] != '(') {
            if (!isInside) {
                if (str[index] == '_') {
                    if (maxLength < countLength)
                        maxLength = countLength;
                    countLength = 0;
                    isInWordOut = false;
                } else {
                    isInWordOut = true;
                }

                if (isInWordOut) {
                    countLength++;
                }
            } else {
                isInWordOut = false;
                if (str[index] == '_') {
                    if (checker > 0)
                        countWord++;
                    checker = 0;
                    isInWordIn = false;
                } else {
                    isInWordIn = true;
                }

                if (isInWordIn) {
                    checker++;
                }
            }
        }

        index++;
    }

    if (maxLength < countLength)
        maxLength = countLength;

    cout << maxLength << " " << countWord << endl;

    return 0;
}
